config.measurement: A SEPARATE DATASET for the repaired finger servo (declared Oct 10, 2026; branch fix/latent-shadow-finger-contract-2026-10-10, docs/gain_of_function_v4/latent_contract_repair/LATENT_CONTRACT_REPAIR.md): rows recorded with --finger-joint-servo on, whose command contract the trainer writes as wrist_relative_joint_v1+finger_joint_servo_v1 (limb_target_control.action_contract_parts appends finger_joint_servo_v1). Every other value is copied unchanged from C:\Users\bhart\Documents\UEMA_devA_private\docs\gain_of_function_v4\latent_body_shadow_config_h84_2026-09-30.json (sha256 8c2c05e6971ce2aeaa2976d8b8bcf8f493415f4d95a05f78e51ea84efc7813ca). They are not measured on rows of this contract (none existed when this file was written); they are kept equal so that weights learned under the old contract can be named as a starting state. Codes bounded by tanh.
